subject: Onboarding verification packet + ID spot-check
messages:
From: Gordon Mills <gordon.mills@securecorp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding verification packet + ID spot-check

Hi Jasmine,

We're starting our SOC 2 scoping for Redwood and need a compact onboarding verification packet covering employee security training completions, background check vendor/coverage, and a short sample demonstrating ID verification and redaction practices (for SOC 2 PII controls). Specifically we need: 

- CSV export or summary showing completed security training for active staff & contractors for the last 24 months
- Confirmation of background check vendor(s) used and the checks performed (identity, criminal, employment) with a sample vendor attestation or contract clause
- A redacted PDF sample of the ID verification that you use during preboarding
- The deprovisioning/runbook entry that shows how access is removed on exit (timelines and responsible roles)

Can you deliver these items within 72 hours? If there are parts that must be redacted for privacy, a short explanation and an unredacted sample provided under an NDA would be fine. Also flag if contractors are excluded.

Thanks — this is for a SIG/SOC 2 mapping exercise, and SecureCorp audit team will treat any PII as confidential.

Regards,
Gordon Mills
Senior Security Manager, SecureCorp
security@securecorp.com

--
Attachment request: training roster, vendor attestation, ID sample, runbook

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Gordon Mills <gordon.mills@securecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding verification packet + ID spot-check

Hi Gordon — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble this and share redacted artifacts via a secure Drive folder. Initial notes: 

- Background vendor: we use Checkify (contracted) for US hires; their package includes identity verification (ID match), SSN trace where permitted, and criminal + employment checks. We will include the vendor attestation PDF.
- Training: attached is a CSV export (training-completions-2025-09.csv) showing completion status by role for active staff and contractors for the requested 24-month window. We redacted email addresses in the public CSV — full identifiers can be shared under a mutual NDA if needed.
- ID check sample: attached a redacted PDF showing our process (id-check-sample-redacted.pdf).
- Deprovisioning: I'm linking the onboarding-runbook-v2.docx from our secure Drive folder and will also attach a short timetable spreadsheet.

Two quick clarifying questions before finalizing:
1) Do you need historical training completions for contractors beyond the 24 months?
2) For vendor attestation, do you prefer a signed contract excerpt or a short attestation letter?

I'll push a full package to the Drive link and share access to SecureCorp. Expect the folder by EOD.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: training-completions-2025-09.csv, id-check-sample-redacted.pdf (redacted sample)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding verification packet + ID spot-check

Jasmine / Naomi — quick follow-up for the packet assembly: 

- Training retention: our LMS keeps completion records for 36 months; for contractors we keep the last 24 months in the primary export and archive older records. If SecureCorp needs 24 months only, the attached export and training-completions-2025-09.csv should be sufficient. If they want 36 months for sampling, we can include an expanded file.
- Deprovisioning: attaching deprovisioning-timelines.xlsx with owner, SLA (hours), and typical automation hooks (deprovision job ids).
- Audit logs: I'll extract a short sample of access revocation events for Sep 2024–Aug 2025 and add to the Drive folder — those will be redacted to remove user identifiers for external sharing.

Let me know and I'll assemble the expanded set.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Security Operations

Attachments: deprovisioning-timelines.xlsx

From: Gordon Mills <gordon.mills@securecorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding verification packet + ID spot-check

Thanks — that looks good. A couple of clarifications from the SecureCorp compliance team: 

- Please include staff and contractors for the requested 24-month window (we do not need 36 months unless there is a gap explanation).
- For the background vendor attestation, a signed attestation PDF that confirms identity-match coverage and retention windows is preferred.
- For ID verification we need (a) a redacted sample (you already provided) and (b) a short paragraph describing how the ID is verified (manual checklist vs automated matching) and who is authorized to view unredacted documents.
- DocuSign: we will send a simple vendor attestation template via DocuSign to speed signature. Expect docuSign@securecorp.com to appear in your inbox shortly.

If you can provide the signed attestation and the short process paragraph by tomorrow EOD PDT that would help us stay on schedule.

Regards,
Gordon

--
SecureCorp Audit Team
DocuSign placeholder: https://example.docusign.com/securecorp/attest/12345

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Gordon Mills <gordon.mills@securecorp.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding verification packet + ID spot-check

Gordon — final package attached and Drive access granted to the SecureCorp domain. Summary of what's included: 

- training-completions-2025-09.csv (active staff + contractors, completion status, role, training id)
- id-check-sample-redacted.pdf (redacted visual sample of ID verification)
- onboarding-runbook-v2.docx (runbook excerpt showing account provisioning and deprovisioning steps)
- deprovisioning-timelines.xlsx (owner and SLA matrix)
- vendor-attestation-checkify-2025.pdf (signed attestation from Checkify confirming identity-match and retention windows)

Process paragraph (for your SOC 2 evidence): 
"Identity verification: Redwood requires ID proof for all US hires and contractors. Checkify performs automated ID-image-to-document matching and flags mismatches to our HR/TS team for manual review. Only HR and Trust & Safety personnel with role-based access (HR Admin, TS Lead) can view unredacted ID documents. Access to unredacted PII is logged in our audit system; sample audit events were added to the Drive folder. Retention policy: unredacted ID documents retained for 12 months post-termination unless required longer by contract."

If you need an unredacted sample, we will exchange an NDA and provide it via a controlled transfer. DocuSign: we received the SecureCorp attestation template and routed it to Checkify for signature — the final signed attestation file (vendor-attestation-checkify-2025.pdf) is attached.

Let me know if anything else is required for your SIG/CAIQ mapping.

Best regards,
Jasmine Liu
Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: training-completions-2025-09.csv, id-check-sample-redacted.pdf, onboarding-runbook-v2.docx, vendor-attestation-checkify-2025.pdf, deprovisioning-timelines.xlsx
